No e2e spec references the removed controls (`34-stats`, `38`, `46` and `47` checked). **Open questions.** Decisions taken that the issue left open, each with the alternative rejected: 1. A gone `?sort=` also resets the direction to descending, because "the default sort" is win rate descending. Rejected: keeping `?dir=asc`, which would show the worst win rate first. 2. The dead CSS is removed and the palette/typescale counts lowered, as #2325 did. Rejected: leaving rules no markup uses. 3. R654 gets no "Amended by" line, since its text never named these columns. Only R1994000 is amended, as the issue asks. Nothing needs a person.
